object_description: two-stage composition of interacting building volumes
design_condition: The volumes interact with the existing buildings and create several external spaces, including a well-defined entrance square, but other spaces remain diffuse or functionally unclear, particularly between the buildings and at the lower level.

positive.statement: The tree-lined gravel square at the entrance is well defined and of high quality.
The portico supports the entrance square and can accommodate various events.
The search for construction solutions aimed at containing costs is appreciated.

negative.statement: The external spaces created by the volumes are not consistently defined or interesting.
The lower-level space between the two buildings has no clear function.
The organization and functionality of the first-stage internal spaces are unconvincing, particularly because the routes are complex and problematic.
The division of the buildings into the two stages, especially the underground part, is not precise.
The cost-oriented construction solutions do not achieve the desired architectural quality.
